Subject: Redwood invoice question / VAT evidence for June billing

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the onboarding call this morning. Our AP team has a couple of quick questions before we can enable automated invoice processing:

- Can Redwood send invoices to our portal (AP inbox at ap@lyrahealth.com) instead of a single billing email? We prefer invoices posted to the portal for automated matching.
- What format will the invoice be in (PDF, XML). Our ERP prefers XML, but we can accept PDF for now.
- We need VAT registration evidence for Redwood for our internal tax team. Can you attach or share a VAT certificate?

I attached a sample purchase order and our AP onboarding template (see references below). If portal posting is not ready this week, please advise the fallback (email + PDF) and who will be the billing contact at Redwood.

Best,
Sophie Martin
Finance Operations Manager
LyraHealth

Attachments: purchase_order_LY-2026-06.pdf (PDF), ap_onboarding_template.xlsx (XLSX)

From: jasmine.liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Redwood invoice question / VAT evidence for June billing

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clarity and the PO. Quick answers up front:

1) Portal vs Email: We can post invoices to your portal via SFTP/API integration (preferred) or send PDF copies to a billing address. Portal posting requires a short onboarding step from your side (SFTP credentials or API key). If you need immediate delivery this week we will email a PDF and set up portal posting as the longer-term solution.

2) Format: Our system can emit both PDF and UBL/XML. For automated ERP ingestion we can enable UBL (XML) exports to the portal.

3) VAT evidence: I can share Redwood's VAT registration PDF. I will also add our finance contact so your tax team has a direct line.

Next steps — can you confirm which you prefer? If portal: please send SFTP details or a temporary API token to ap@redwood.com (or we can coordinate a secure file exchange). If email: confirm the exact billing email to send to and whether you want copies to cc to the PO contact.

I'll attach the VAT PDF and a short collection matrix that shows how we can route invoices per entity. @Laura — can you review the proposed sender and payment terms once Sophie confirms? @Ben — please hold on setting the invoice sender until we lock the channel.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_VAT_registration_2024.pdf (PDF), collection_matrix_v1.xlsx (XLSX)
